mcp_tools.name: data_analysis_deliverable
mcp_tools.title: Data analysis deliverable
mcp_tools.description: Submits a data-analysis deliverable record (question framing, data provenance, declared figures with re-derivation inputs, statistical care, insight and action, reporting and reproducibility) and returns a deterministic DELIVERABLE_COMPLETE / DELIVERABLE_NOT_COMPLETE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed re-derivation of the stated total, mean and percent change from declared values, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it runs no analysis and certifies no conclusions.

inputSchema.description: The analysis-deliverable record manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All flags pass; values [10,20] sum 30 mean 15; (110-100)/100*100=10.

method step 7: caveats are stated in the report
red line: no charts that oversell
method step 7 / quality gate: numbers are reproducible — results reproducible
method step 8: after the action, predicted vs actual is compared — close the loop
